```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7
)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# Set paths
project_dir <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects/crispr_screen/ht1080_loy_screen_2"
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results")
rnaseq_dir <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE"

# Data file paths
drugz_file <- file.path(results_dir, "drugZ/LOY_vs_CTRL_unfiltered.txt")
mageck_file <- file.path(project_dir, "test/POST_LOY_vs_CTRL.gene_summary.txt")
rnaseq_de_file <- file.path(rnaseq_dir, "ht1080_LOY_v_WT_DE_noY.csv")
rnaseq_expr_file <- file.path(rnaseq_dir, "lcpm_matrix.csv")
count_file <- file.path(project_dir, "count/ht1080_screen2_R1.count.txt")
integrated_file <- file.path(results_dir, "module3_integrated_data.csv")

# Essential gene files
essential_file <- file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesCommonEssentialControls.csv")
nonessential_file <- file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesNonessentialControls.csv")

# Thresholds
FDR_THRESHOLD <- 0.5
```

# 1. Data Loading

```{r load-drugz}
# Load drugZ results (primary source)
drugz <- read_tsv(drugz_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(gene = GENE)

cat("drugZ results loaded:", nrow(drugz), "genes\n")
```

```{r load-mageck}
# Load MAGeCK results for LFC values
mageck <- read_tsv(mageck_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(mageck) <- gsub("[|]", "_", colnames(mageck))

mageck <- mageck %>%
  rename(gene = id) %>%
  select(gene, num,
         mageck_neg_lfc = neg_lfc,
         mageck_neg_fdr = neg_fdr,
         mageck_goodsgrna = neg_goodsgrna)

cat("MAGeCK results loaded:", nrow(mageck), "genes\n")
```

```{r load-rnaseq-de}
# Load RNA-seq DE results
rnaseq_de <- read_csv(rnaseq_de_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene_name,
         rnaseq_logFC = logFC,
         rnaseq_FDR = FDR)

cat("RNA-seq DE results loaded:", nrow(rnaseq_de), "genes\n")
```

```{r load-rnaseq-expr}
# Load RNA-seq expression matrix (log2-CPM per replicate)
rnaseq_expr <- read_csv(rnaseq_expr_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Get the gene name column (first column)
gene_col <- colnames(rnaseq_expr)[1]

# Select HT1080 columns only and rename
ht1080_cols <- colnames(rnaseq_expr)[grepl("ht1080", colnames(rnaseq_expr), ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat("HT1080 expression columns found:", paste(ht1080_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

rnaseq_expr <- rnaseq_expr %>%
  select(all_of(c(gene_col, ht1080_cols))) %>%
  rename(gene_id = 1)

# Rename columns to cleaner names
colnames(rnaseq_expr) <- gsub("ht1080_", "rnaseq_", colnames(rnaseq_expr), ignore.case = TRUE)

cat("RNA-seq expression loaded:", nrow(rnaseq_expr), "genes,", ncol(rnaseq_expr) - 1, "HT1080 samples\n")
```

```{r load-crispr-counts}
# Load CRISPR counts and calculate gene-level normalized CPM
counts_raw <- read_tsv(count_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(counts_raw)[1:2] <- c("sgRNA", "Gene")

# Calculate library-size normalized CPM per sample
sample_cols <- colnames(counts_raw)[3:ncol(counts_raw)]
lib_sizes <- colSums(counts_raw[, sample_cols])

cpm_matrix <- counts_raw %>%
  select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  sweep(2, lib_sizes, "/") * 1e6

# Combine and calculate gene-level averages
counts_gene <- counts_raw %>%
  select(sgRNA, Gene) %>%
  bind_cols(cpm_matrix) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_sgrnas = n(),
    D0_CTRL_cpm = mean(D0_CTRL),
    D0_LOY_cpm = mean(D0_LOY),
    POST_CTRL_REP1_cpm = mean(POST_CTRL_REP1),
    POST_CTRL_REP2_cpm = mean(POST_CTRL_REP2),
    POST_LOY_REP1_cpm = mean(POST_LOY_REP1),
    POST_LOY_REP2_cpm = mean(POST_LOY_REP2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(gene = Gene)

cat("CRISPR counts loaded:", nrow(counts_gene), "genes\n")
```

```{r load-integrated}
# Load integrated data for concordance and X-linked status
integrated <- read_csv(integrated_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene, is_x_linked, chromosome, concordance, crispr_good_sgrna)

cat("Integrated data loaded:", nrow(integrated), "genes\n")
```

```{r load-essential}
# Load essential gene lists
essential_genes <- read_csv(essential_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pull(1) %>%
  str_extract("^[^\\s(]+")

cat("Essential genes loaded:", length(essential_genes), "genes\n")
```

# 2. Gene Annotations

```{r define-gene-lists}
# SAGA/STAGA complex members
saga_genes <- c(
  # Core module
  "SUPT3H", "SUPT7L", "SUPT20H", "TAF5L", "TAF6L", "TAF9", "TAF10", "TAF12",
  # HAT module
  "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "TADA2B", "TADA3", "SGF29", "TADA1",

  # DUB module
  "USP22", "ATXN7", "ATXN7L3", "ENY2",
  # Splicing module
  "SF3B3", "SF3B5",
  # TRRAP
  "TRRAP"
)

# Y chromosome genes lost in LOY
y_genes <- c("UTY", "USP9Y", "DDX3Y", "EIF1AY", "RPS4Y1", "ZFY",
             "NLGN4Y", "KDM5D", "TBL1Y", "TMSB4Y")

# Known X-linked paralogs (potential synthetic lethal candidates)
x_paralogs <- c("DDX3X", "UTX", "KDM6A", "USP9X", "EIF1AX", "RPS4X",
                "ZFX", "NLGN4X", "KDM5C", "TBL1X", "TMSB4X")

cat("Gene lists defined:\n")
cat("- SAGA complex:", length(saga_genes), "genes\n")
cat("- Y chromosome:", length(y_genes), "genes\n")
cat("- X-linked paralogs:", length(x_paralogs), "genes\n")
```

# 3. Build Master Table

```{r build-master-table}
# Start with drugZ as base (has all genes)
master_table <- drugz %>%
  # Join MAGeCK
  left_join(mageck, by = "gene") %>%
  # Join RNA-seq DE
  left_join(rnaseq_de, by = c("gene" = "gene_name")) %>%
  # Join RNA-seq expression (need to match gene names)
  left_join(rnaseq_expr, by = c("gene" = "gene_id")) %>%
  # Join CRISPR counts
  left_join(counts_gene, by = "gene") %>%
  # Join integrated data

  left_join(integrated, by = "gene") %>%
  # Add evidence columns
  mutate(
    is_essential = gene %in% essential_genes,
    is_saga = gene %in% saga_genes,
    is_x_paralog = gene %in% x_paralogs,
    is_y_gene = gene %in% y_genes,
    # Use X-linked from integrated data, fall back to x_paralogs list
    is_x_linked = coalesce(is_x_linked, gene %in% x_paralogs),
    num_good_sgrnas = coalesce(crispr_good_sgrna, as.integer(mageck_goodsgrna)),
    # Significance flag
    is_significant = fdr_synth < FDR_THRESHOLD,
    # Empty annotation columns for curation
    notes = "",
    priority = "",
    validation_status = ""
  ) %>%
  # Select and order columns
  select(
    # Gene info
    gene, chromosome,
    # drugZ stats
    rank_synth, sumZ, normZ, fdr_synth, fdr_supp,
    # MAGeCK
    mageck_neg_lfc, mageck_neg_fdr,
    # RNA-seq DE
    rnaseq_logFC, rnaseq_FDR,
    # RNA-seq expression per replicate
    starts_with("rnaseq_ctrl"), starts_with("rnaseq_loy"),
    # CRISPR counts per replicate
    POST_CTRL_REP1_cpm, POST_CTRL_REP2_cpm,
    POST_LOY_REP1_cpm, POST_LOY_REP2_cpm,
    D0_CTRL_cpm, D0_LOY_cpm,
    # Evidence flags
    is_essential, is_x_linked, is_x_paralog, is_saga, is_y_gene,
    concordance, num_good_sgrnas, n_sgrnas,
    # Annotation columns
    notes, priority, validation_status,
    is_significant
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank_synth)

cat("\n=== MASTER TABLE BUILT ===\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(master_table), "\n")
cat("Significant hits (FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "):", sum(master_table$is_significant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# 4. Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats}
sig_hits <- master_table %>% filter(is_significant)

cat("=== SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT HITS (FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, ") ===\n\n")
cat("Total synthetic lethal hits:", nrow(sig_hits), "\n")
cat("X-linked genes:", sum(sig_hits$is_x_linked, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("X-linked paralogs (of Y genes):", sum(sig_hits$is_x_paralog, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("SAGA complex members:", sum(sig_hits$is_saga, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Essential genes (Achilles):", sum(sig_hits$is_essential, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("With RNA-seq support (FDR < 0.1):", sum(!is.na(sig_hits$rnaseq_FDR) & sig_hits$rnaseq_FDR < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r highlight-genes}
# Show key gene categories
cat("\n=== X-LINKED PARALOG HITS ===\n")
master_table %>%
  filter(is_significant & is_x_paralog) %>%
  select(gene, rank_synth, normZ, fdr_synth, mageck_neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

cat("\n=== SAGA COMPLEX HITS ===\n")
master_table %>%
  filter(is_significant & is_saga) %>%
  select(gene, rank_synth, normZ, fdr_synth, mageck_neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

# 5. Interactive Hit Tables

## 5.1 Significant Hits (FDR < `r FDR_THRESHOLD`)

```{r significant-hits-table}
# Prepare display table for significant hits
sig_display <- master_table %>%
  filter(is_significant) %>%
  mutate(
    sumZ = round(sumZ, 2),
    normZ = round(normZ, 2),
    fdr_synth = signif(fdr_synth, 3),
    fdr_supp = signif(fdr_supp, 3),
    mageck_neg_lfc = round(mageck_neg_lfc, 3),
    mageck_neg_fdr = signif(mageck_neg_fdr, 3),
    rnaseq_logFC = round(rnaseq_logFC, 3),
    rnaseq_FDR = signif(rnaseq_FDR, 3),
    across(starts_with("rnaseq_ctrl") | starts_with("rnaseq_loy"), ~round(.x, 2)),
    across(ends_with("_cpm"), ~round(.x, 1))
  ) %>%
  select(-is_significant)

DT::datatable(
  sig_display,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "ColReorder", "FixedHeader"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    fixedHeader = TRUE,
    colReorder = TRUE,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = list(
      list(extend = "csv", filename = "HT1080_significant_hits"),
      list(extend = "excel", filename = "HT1080_significant_hits"),
      list(extend = "copy"),
      list(extend = "colvis", text = "Column visibility")
    )
  ),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;",
    paste0("HT1080 LOY Synthetic Lethal Hits (FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD, ") - ", nrow(sig_display), " genes")
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "is_x_paralog",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(TRUE, "#cce5ff")
  ) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "is_saga",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(TRUE, "#fff3cd")
  ) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "is_essential",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(TRUE, "#f8d7da")
  )
```

## 5.2 Full Gene Table (All Genes)

```{r full-table}
# Prepare full display table
full_display <- master_table %>%
  mutate(
    sumZ = round(sumZ, 2),
    normZ = round(normZ, 2),
    fdr_synth = signif(fdr_synth, 3),
    fdr_supp = signif(fdr_supp, 3),
    mageck_neg_lfc = round(mageck_neg_lfc, 3),
    mageck_neg_fdr = signif(mageck_neg_fdr, 3),
    rnaseq_logFC = round(rnaseq_logFC, 3),
    rnaseq_FDR = signif(rnaseq_FDR, 3),
    across(starts_with("rnaseq_ctrl") | starts_with("rnaseq_loy"), ~round(.x, 2)),
    across(ends_with("_cpm"), ~round(.x, 1))
  ) %>%
  select(-is_significant)

DT::datatable(
  full_display,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "ColReorder"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    colReorder = TRUE,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = list(
      list(extend = "csv", filename = "HT1080_all_genes"),
      list(extend = "excel", filename = "HT1080_all_genes"),
      list(extend = "copy"),
      list(extend = "colvis", text = "Column visibility")
    )
  ),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-size: 14px;",
    "Full Gene Table (all genes, use filters to narrow)"
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

# 6. Save Output

```{r save-output}
# Save master table to CSV
output_file <- file.path(results_dir, "HT1080_CRISPR_hits_evidence_table.csv")
write_csv(master_table, output_file)
cat("\nFull table saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Also save significant hits separately
sig_output_file <- file.path(results_dir, "HT1080_CRISPR_significant_hits.csv")
write_csv(master_table %>% filter(is_significant), sig_output_file)
cat("Significant hits saved to:", sig_output_file, "\n")
```
